name: hcportal_getCities
description: Returns the cities for a given region from HC.City, ordered alphabetically by CityName. Used to populate the cascading Country -> Region -> City selector in the run editor. Requires standard portal authentication.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Filter: only cities whose RegionId matches are returned.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on any validation, auth, or runtime error. Short-circuits on first error.

rowsets.name: CitiesResult
rowsets.description: List of cities for the given region, ordered alphabetically by CityName. Only returned on successful authentication.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
